thread:
jess_partners: Quick sync — proposing a hands-on enablement workshop for Nimbus Cloud partners next Tues. Goal: ship a marketplace quickstart that includes a reference arch, Terraform modules, and Terrascan policy checks. 1hr + breakout. Thoughts?

mike_eng: love it. main ask: we need infra owner for module CI and smoke tests. can @dylan_infra own that?

dylan_infra: I can. prefer to split into two tracks: packaging/marketplace submission + infra/security (policies + CI).

jess_partners: exactly — track A = packaging & partner docs (anya), track B = infra + security (dylan + mike). attendees: partner eng lead, SI lead, 2 of our SDK folks.

anya_docs: I'll draft the partner-facing quickstart template and a short checklist: prerequisites, terraform init/apply, marketplace bundle. will post doc this afternoon.

mike_eng: for Terrascan rules we should include a simple example rule set: deny wide open sg, enforce kms for storage, require resource tags. helps partners pass their security gate.

jess_partners: agreed. also runbook item: what fallback model do we recommend for partners if a module fails marketplace validation? e.g., publish as \"community\" then iterate?

dylan_infra: fallback = publish as private bundle to partner account for dev, then resubmit. we'll document validation steps to catch common errors earlier (provider version mismatch, missing variables).

terra-bot: New scan job created: terrascan-scan-template. Trigger: github PR to modules/* -> runs policies/stats. (automated)

mike_eng: can we show a quick CI snippet in the workshop? something like:
```yaml
name: module-ci
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Terrascan
        run: terrascan scan -v -p policies/ 
```

anya_docs: perfect — I'll include that in the quickstart doc and the workshop slides. also add a "common fixes" section.

sara_pm: timeline: workshop next Tue 10am PT. pre-req: partners must have a sandbox account and a small test dataset. partners to RSVP by Fri. please confirm speakers + slides by EOD Mon.

mike_eng: i'll take the infra/security demo (30m). dylan will do CI + smoke-runbook (20m). anya will walk through packaging + docs (15m). leaving 10m for Q&A.

jess_partners: thanks. I'll send calendar invite + RSVP form. partner-facing repo will be under org: redwood-partners/nimbus-quickstart. we'll open an initial PR with the template before the workshop.

dylan_infra: action items: 1) create repo skeleton + GH actions CI (due Mon EOD) 2) terrascan baseline policies (due Mon EOD) 3) anya to draft quickstart doc (due Mon EOD).

mike_eng: tagging follow-up: @sara_pm please confirm partner contact list. I'll add sample smoke tests (terraform apply -> simple inference call) to validate end-to-end.

jess_partners: great — if anyone thinks we should also bake in quantization/ampere guidance for Nimbus hardware, flag now. otherwise keep scope focused on packaging + policies.

anya_docs: noted — will add an "advanced" appendix for hardware tuning but not part of the core sprint.

sara_pm: RSVP link: https://forms.gle/example (placeholder). partner invite goes out after repo PR.

jess_partners: thanks all. quick wins = repo + CI + doc. we'll reconvene Mon 9am to validate everything before the partner workshop. :thumbsup:
